races.display_title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict: NESWICK proved suited by the step up in trip when making a winning start to life in handicaps at Southwell and can defy a 2 lb weights rise with likely better still to come from this lightly-raced sort. Wolverhampton scorer Fiefdom also has relatively few miles on the clock and is feared most, while the handily-weighted Percy Jones and C&D winner Fair Dinkum can also have a say in this intriguing handicap. NESWICK FIEFDOM (IRE) PERCY JONES

races.verdict: Not a deep maiden so it could be worth chancing GREEN SPAIN , who didn't show masses on debut in France this summer but that was a pretty warm race and her pedigree and connections suggest she'll up her game. Uomo Valeroso showed enough starting out at Kempton to think he'll be involved, with Rhythm Runner , Gilded Outlaw and Sand On The Run interesting newcomers on paper. GREEN SPAIN UOMO VALEROSO (USA) RHYTHM RUNNER

races.display_title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
races.verdict: DEFIANT DREAM took a step forward when runner-up at Nottingham last time and is weighted to go one better and gain a first success off just a 1 lb higher mark here. Fancied Angel didn't enjoy the rub of the green when a recent fifth at Wolverhampton and is next on the list with likely better to come. Last Dandelion and Past Passion appeal also and need considering in this open nursery. DEFIANT DREAM FANCIED ANGEL LAST DANDELION

races.verdict: MEHMAR only just failed to justify sustained support starting out for his new yard when second at Southwell 31 days ago, splitting a pair of next-time-out winners in the process. He remains very well handicapped on the back of 4 lb rise based on past exploits and rates a major player from a handy draw. Black Missile also arrives on the back of a solid effort and is next best, whilst Knicks has the ability to play a part if putting it all together, too. MEHMAR (IRE) BLACK MISSILE (IRE) KNICKS (IRE)

races.verdict: PROSEWRITER did well under the circumstances and looked a good prospect to boot when making a winning debut in a Southwell novice 4 weeks ago. Well-bred and open to improvement, he may well be up to defying a penalty and go 2-2. Gombey Rhythm cost plenty at the breeze-ups last year and the booking of Billy Loughnane signals intent ahead of debut. Baandee and Flag of Nations complete the dangers. PROSEWRITER (IRE) GOMBEY RHYTHM BAANDEE

races.display_title: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: NOBODY TOLD ME is selected to make a winning start for new trainer Dan Skelton, with confidence in his chance increased should the betting vibes be strong. Yourcardismarked has also been the subject of an interesting trainer change and support for him would make him a potentially dangerous opponent. Laplander should be up to doing something off this mark based on Flat ability, while it would also be no surprise were Cheap Sandwiches to prove a different proposition in handicaps. NOBODY TOLD ME YOURCARDISMARKED (IRE) LAPLANDER

races.display_title: Christmas Jumper Day Sunday 13th December Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: IN THE PURPLE hasn't been seen since a C&D handicap success in February but he took that in the style of one who should have more to offer for a leading stable. The Boss Bear couldn't justify favouritism but still made a sound start for the James Owen yard at Plumpton 3 weeks ago and heads the many possible dangers along with Presenting Milan and Dan Skelton's Typhoon Warrior , who is bred to be suited by this longer trip. IN THE PURPLE (IRE) THE BOSS BEAR (IRE) PRESENTING MILAN (IRE)

races.verdict: REBEL REBA could only manage second when odds on for a maiden hurdle at Fairyhouse recently but a point win at the start of her career suggests she's worth another chance now chasing. Gavin Cromwell has won this 3 times since 2021 so his Naas handicap hurdle winner Let's Go Mans rates a possible danger. Walk In The Clouds has a profile which suggests she should take to chasing, while Kimy has placed in similar events this autumn. REBEL REBA (IRE) LET'S GO MANS (FR) WALK IN THE CLOUDS (IRE)

races.verdict: This doesn't look the strongest of bumpers, so LADY AURORA makes obvious appeal having joined Willie Mullins after running out an easy winner on her completed start in points. Found It should be capable of building on her opening effort under Rules at Punchestown in early-May, while Shuil Solas bumped into a good prospect on her penultimate outing and merits respect back in calmer waters. LADY AURORA (FR) FOUND IT (IRE) SHUIL SOLAS (IRE)
